title: Case: Freight planner messages the desk the afternoon before a two-pallet shelving delivery
context: Two pallets of flat-pack shelving from Tallowmere Goods are booked for a tail-lift delivery to a print works. The freight planner owns the booking and the load plan and deals with the receiving site directly.
initial_request: FYI only. DL-6476 has moved from trailer T-31 to T-44 for tomorrow's run after a load-balancing change at the hub. Both pallets scanned onto T-44 at 15:12. Same tail-lift vehicle type, same booked window 08:00–12:00, FB-8695 unchanged. I have told Nerys at Kessock directly and she has acknowledged. No action required from the desk, this is for your records.

events.body: DL-6476, 2 pallets flat-pack shelving, Tallowmere Goods to Kessock Print Works. Booked tail-lift delivery 2027-05-06, 08:00–12:00 UTC, booking FB-8695. Receiving contact Nerys Drummond has confirmed the window and that a pallet truck is on site.

events.from: Nerys Drummond, receiving coordinator, Kessock Print Works
events.body: Confirming we have the Thursday morning booking from your freight planner, FB-8695. Goods-in opens 07:30. Don't need anything from you, just putting it on your file as well.

FYI only. DL-6476 has moved from trailer T-31 to T-44 for tomorrow's run after a load-balancing change at the hub. Both pallets scanned onto T-44 at 15:12. Same tail-lift vehicle type, same booked window 08:00–12:00, FB-8695 unchanged. I have told Nerys at Kessock directly and she has acknowledged. No action required from the desk, this is for your records.

FYI only. DL-6476 has moved from trailer T-31 to T-44 for tomorrow's run after a load-balancing change at the hub. Both pallets scanned onto T-44 at 15:12. Same tail-lift vehicle type, same booked window 08:00–12:00, FB-8695 unchanged. I have told Nerys at Kessock directly and she has acknowledged. No action required from the desk, this is for your records.

must: Takes no action and sends no message to anyone.
Records the planner's update as information only: trailer changed from T-31 to T-44, booking FB-8695 and the 08:00–12:00 window on 2027-05-06 unchanged.
Notes that the freight planner owns the booking, has already told the receiving coordinator, and has said no action is required from the desk.
Notes that the desk next needs to look only if the planner or the receiving site reports a change to the window or a problem on the day.
must_not: Messages Nerys Drummond to pass on the trailer change she has already had from the freight planner.
Replies to the freight planner asking them to confirm the window or the booking again.
Tells the receiving site the pallets will arrive at a particular time, or that the delivery is confirmed as arriving, on the strength of a load scan.
Treats the trailer change as a delay or an exception and raises it with Dispatch or a supervisor.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)

rationale: Rule-made from gen-1103: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
